messages:
jamie: Heads up — staging showed a sudden 502/timeout spike for the embed path after the quant revert. Root cause looks like a serializer mismatch in the new runtime build. We need a quick hotfix cut to prod and pin the image. Proposing image: `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-hotfix:2024-07-13-rc2`

deploybot: Deploy request received (ID: dr-8421). Required approvals: ops-oncall, release-manager. Canary window suggested: 5m. Flags: expedited=true, canary=true.

sai: I can take oncall for this. How wide is the impact in prod? any upstream deps at risk?

jamie: Impact in staging ~3% of embedding requests; failing fast for short sequences. In prod traffic only hits this path for ~0.5% of requests, but error mode could ramp. Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 800ms OR error rate increase > 2% sustained for 5m.

jamie: Rollback steps (copy/paste):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-10
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# if emergency
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=42
```

alex: Infra +1 for an expedited window. I can open a 10m midwindow at 17:44 UTC. Need release notes link and a short reason line. Also please pin the config map change in the release. @nina please review.

nina: I'll approve provided staging ran canary for >=15m. Do we have that evidence? Also include the CV/rollback rationale in the notes.

jamie: Canary completed in staging for 18m with no errors after tweak. Release note: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2024-07-13-embed-hotfix (short: fix serializer mismatch after quant revert; pin image to rc2; rollback criteria included). I've updated the changelog and added configmap hash: `cfg-hash: a7c9e2`.

jamie: deploybot run `expedited-deploy --id dr-8421 --force --midwindow 10m --notify #incidents,#eng-releases`

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-8421 -> prod. Canary enabled (5m) then progressive rollout. Midwindow reserved 10m starting 1718273685. Monitors: /metrics/embeds/error_rate, p95_latency, kv-cache-miss. Watchers: sai, alex, jamie, nina. Logging tail: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 50`

ops-bot: Alerting ramp set: 30s. Runbook bound: /runbooks/embed-quant-hotfix. Pager escalation: if error_rate > 2% for 5m -> page ops-lead and open incident.

sai: Oncall ACK. I'll be watching p95 and error_rate. If thresholds hit I'll trigger rollback (kubectl undo) and post here + page #incidents.

jamie: Thanks team — postmortem/short blameless notes to follow after stabilization. :thumbsup:
